name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualDiv
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (x : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l), (∀ φ : D, (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 → x φ = 0) →
∃ y : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, x = (l : ℤ_[l]) • y := by
let μ : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] D := (l : ℤ_[l]) • LinearMap.id
have hker : LinearMap.ker μ ≤ LinearMap.ker x := by
exact hx φ (by simpa [μ] using hφ)
let g : LinearMap.range μ →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l :=
obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (qzInj l).out (LinearMap.range μ).subtype Subtype.val_injective g
have hmem : μ φ ∈ LinearMap.range μ := LinearMap.mem_range_self μ φ
have h3 : (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μ).symm ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = Submodule.Quotient.mk φ := by
have h2 : g ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = x φ := by
simp only [Submodule.coe_subtype, μ, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h1
assume: Assume `(∀ φ : D, (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 → x φ = 0)` (hx).
show: Let D be a ℤℓ-module and let x be a linear functional D → ℚℓ/ℤℓ. If x vanishes on D[ℓ], then there is a linear functional y on D with x = ℓy.
strategy: Factor x through multiplication by ℓ and extend the resulting functional by injectivity of ℚℓ/ℤℓ.

steps.claim: Let μ be multiplication by ℓ on the ℤℓ-module D. Its kernel is the ℓ-torsion D[ℓ], on which the functional x is assumed to vanish.
steps.snippet:
∃ y : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, x = (l : ℤ_[l]) • y := by
  intro l _ D _ _ x hx
  let μ : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] D := (l : ℤ_[l]) • LinearMap.id

steps.claim: The inclusion ker μ ⊆ ker x follows because μ(φ) = 0 means ℓφ = 0, and the vanishing hypothesis then gives x(φ) = 0.
steps.snippet:
have hker : LinearMap.ker μ ≤ LinearMap.ker x := by
    intro φ hφ
    exact hx φ (by simpa [μ] using hφ)

steps.claim: The kernel inclusion lets x descend to D/ker μ. Transporting this functional along D/ker μ ≅ ℓD gives g on ℓD. Since ℚℓ/ℤℓ is an injective ℤℓ-module, g extends across ℓD ⊆ D to a linear functional y on D.
steps.snippet:
let g : LinearMap.range μ →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l :=
    ((LinearMap.ker μ).liftQ x hker).comp (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μ).symm.toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (qzInj l).out (LinearMap.range μ).subtype Subtype.val_injective g
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  ext φ

steps.claim: For every φ in D, μ(φ) belongs to the image of μ with preimage φ.
steps.snippet: have hmem : μ φ ∈ LinearMap.range μ := LinearMap.mem_range_self μ φ

steps.claim: On the image element μ(φ), the extension property of y gives y(μ(φ)) = g(μ(φ)).
The canonical isomorphism D/ker μ → im μ sends the class of φ to μ(φ). Its inverse therefore takes that image element to the class of φ.
steps.snippet:
have h3 : (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μ).symm ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = Submodule.Quotient.mk φ := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl

steps.claim: By construction, g first takes μ(φ) back to the class of φ and then evaluates the functional induced by x. It follows that g(μ(φ)) = x(φ).
steps.snippet:
have h2 : g ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = x φ := by
    simp only [g, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [h3, Submodule.liftQ_apply]

steps.claim: Combining the two evaluations gives x(φ) = y(ℓφ) = ℓy(φ), where the last equality is linearity of y. Equality on every φ gives x = ℓy.
steps.snippet:
rw [h2] at h1
  simp only [Submodule.coe_subtype, μ, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h1
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, ← h1, map_smul]

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
